newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietsovpetro matches 1995 oil output by end-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Vietsovpetro matches 1995 oil output by end-Oct.

text.p: Vietsovpetro matched its 1995 oil output of 6.7 million tonnes by the end of October, the Communist Party daily Nhan Dan said on Saturday.
Nhan Dan said the Vietnamese-Russian joint venture had exported 6.57 million tonnes of oil in the first ten months of this year.
A report in the official Saigon Giai Phong said recently that Vietsovpetro was on track to pump eight million tonnes of oil and and 150 cubic metres of gas this year.

Vietsovpetro produces the bulk of Vietnam's oil, with other companies accounting for around one million tonnes of combined output last year. Most of the country's oil comes from the Bach Ho (White Tiger) field and is exported for refining.
